title: Minimal header
description: The top row of a detail or settings page inside AppShell: where the page sits on the left (a Breadcrumb), one text link and one primary action on the right. The page's own heading follows it.
when: A detail page (one order, one customer) or a settings page reached from a list.
A page with one main action and at most one secondary link.

instead.need: A list page with filters, search and refresh

instead.use: MinimalHeader primary + Menu in the page

a11y: A header element; the Breadcrumb is its own nav landmark.
The link is hidden below sm: never make it the only way to reach something.
notes: One primary (Button variant="primary") at most: a second filled button on the screen breaks the one-primary rule (§4b, §4c).
It sits above the page heading (PageTitle or TextTabs), inside AppShell's content container.
